summary: My own sandbox screenshot (reviews/s74-a.png) shows three plush piglets, a woolly sheep and a jelly blob living on the island and clearly better than the old capsules; they read well at daylight size. The flying pose is still not done and the crab is still a primitive.
surprise_why: Friends visibly turning into plush piglets, sheep and jelly blobs changes what fills every frame.

findings.what: The flight pose (upright, dangling legs) and warm-light films are still only planned; the golden-hour and morning films were not seen finished. Goal 6 is mostly promised.
findings.suggestion: Do the real flying pose first next session; look at the golden take before it goes on the post.

findings.what: Piglet belly/leg seams show ragged flaps at close range at night (media/s74/piglet-2.png), and the new bodies have no painted faces for feelings. At normal camera distance in daylight (reviews/s74-a.png) the seams are not visible.
findings.suggestion: Overlap the leg pieces into the body, then add simple eyes and a mouth.

findings.what: The crab is still a primitive, so the cast looks mixed.
findings.evidence: reviews/s74-a.png: the capsule-style crab by the pond next to the plush pigs
findings.suggestion: Cut the crab the same way once its asset is checked.
